name: environment
command: rustc -Vv; cargo -V; Rscript -e 'sessionInfo(); print(extSoftVersion()); print(parallel::detectCores()); print(packageVersion("WGCNA"))'; uname -a; sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string hw.memsize hw.logicalcpu; git rev-parse HEAD; git ls-remote origin HEAD refs/heads/master

name: input_alignment
command: Rscript -e 'x<-read.delim("Demo/WGCNA_fpkm_data.txt",check.names=FALSE,row.names=1);y<-read.delim("Demo/WGCNA_data_trait.txt",check.names=FALSE,row.names=1);stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(x)),!anyDuplicated(colnames(x)),!anyDuplicated(rownames(y)),identical(colnames(x),rownames(y)),all(is.finite(as.matrix(x))),all(is.finite(as.matrix(y))));cat(nrow(x),ncol(x),"gene/sample IDs unique and trait order identical\n")'

name: unchanged_production
command: git diff --exit-code -- src Cargo.toml Cargo.lock Demo bench_out report/benchmark.html

name: validation_script_syntax
command: python3 -m py_compile validation/audit/*.py && bash -n scripts/run_parity.sh && Rscript -e 'for(p in c(list.files("scripts",pattern="[.]R$",full.names=TRUE),list.files("validation/audit",pattern="[.]R$",full.names=TRUE))) parse(p);cat("R scripts parsed successfully\n")'

name: final_production_diff
command: git diff --exit-code -- src Cargo.toml Cargo.lock Demo bench_out report/benchmark.html
